# CIS - Dragnet Study

> The CIS - Dragnet Study (2026 edition) is the State of Stockbroking Operations and Investor Experience in Nigeria. It is a study of the Chartered Institute of Stockbrokers (CIS), delivered with Dragnet Solutions Limited. It measures how Nigeria's stockbroking firms operate and how their investors experience them, side by side.

## Key facts
- Survey opens: Monday 9 November 2026
- Survey closes: Friday 11 December 2026
- Reports published: Friday 15 January 2027
- Who takes part: stockbroking firms (by CIS invitation; each firm names its MD or CEO, Head of Compliance and Head of Operations); individual investors, Nigerian institutional investors and institutional investors abroad; and six market institutions by invitation (SEC, NGX, CSCS, FMDQ, NASD, LCFE)
- Outputs: a public Industry report; an Institutional Perspectives section; a private Firm report for each participating firm
- Confidentiality: answers are reported only in aggregate; no figure based on fewer than ten respondents is published; firms never see investors' or colleagues' answers; no firm receives another named firm's results
- Contact: support@cisdragnetstudy.com

- [How your information is handled](https://cisdragnetstudy.com/privacy.html): what is collected and how answers are protected and reported
